$fixture: per-harness idle-at-turn-boundary probes and what deliver() does with each verdict
$rule: no verdict admits a write. A write is admitted only by a receiver-owned primitive: a native enqueue, or the receiver's atomic accept at its own turn boundary. Absent one the pointer stays in the durable inbox however idle the transcript looks. The probes below are roster surface and enqueue suppression.

claude.idle: last 'assistant' record has stop_reason 'end_turn' and no later 'user', 'tool_result' or 'queue-operation' record, and mtime stable for 750 ms
claude.busy: last 'assistant' record has stop_reason 'tool_use', or a 'user' record with tool_result content is the tail

codex.idle: rollout present and no thread writer lock
codex.unknown: writer marker present but the platform cannot prove it is held
codex.preferredPath: codex queue --thread <id> --message <pointer>; the harness's own inbox needs no readiness, so the pane is the fallback

grok.effect: never typed; pointer stays pending in the durable inbox

bravo.effect: never typed; pointer stays pending in the durable inbox

omp.note: --mode json reports usage, not turn state

hermes.reason: one-shot is not a peer; spawn refuses

exitRace.case: the child exits between the verdict and the write
exitRace.expected: terminal.write throws on a closed Bun.Terminal; the delivery reverts to pending; no bytes reach any shell because the ConPTY has no shell once the child is gone
exitRace.tier: measured: 'closed' is true after close() on Bun 1.3.14

$revised: 2026-09-05: a sampled idle hint is not a cross-process input transaction. The child can enter an approval dialog, or the human can start editing, after the observation and before the write, with nothing updating the transcript in between. Turn-safe delivery is earned by a native enqueue primitive or a receiver-side admission handshake, never by a sampled hint.

acknowledgement.doesNotProve: the turn state at write time

$openSchedule.statement: no sampled observation and no after-write acknowledgement closes the window between observation and write
$openSchedule.measuredBy: test 3's turn-state cases, whose green is that no write occurred

$revised2: 2026-09-05 re-review: same-tick idle removed as an admission. A receipt ACK proves receipt only and does not close the pre-write turn-state race.

admission.unbuilt: receiver-atomic-accept, the general form, P4 work not shipped here

$outcomes.ack-pending: written under an admission, receipt outstanding
